thread:
sam-support: Hey team, customer "DataLoop" reports invoice shows 10 embedding units but dashboard and their call logs show 7 vectors returned. They used embeddings + rerank in a single flow.

maria-eng: Can you share the request_id and the raw payload (strip any PII)?

sam-support: req_f3a2b1c. Payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
model: embed-v2
inputs: [\"QA snippet\", \"Long doc excerpt (3k chars)\", \"summary\", \"QA snippet\", \"title\", \"short\", \"short\"]
options: { pairwise: true, rerank_mode: "dense" }
```
Customer says dashboard shows 7 embeddings but invoice line: model=embed-v2, units=10. They insist they only passed a single embeddings call.

mina-ml: Two quick flags: 1) pairwise=true can trigger pairwise/rerank accounting if the client then calls the rerank endpoint or if the SDK auto-invokes pairwise scoring. 2) duplicates in the payload might be collapsed in UI but billed differently.
maria-eng: I pulled the runtime trace for req_f3a2b1c. Summary: request routed to two workers, a pairwise postprocess step invoked (via rerank microservice) for top-K comparisons, and there was a retry on one sub-batch. Snippet: 
```
[12:10:02.001] router: embed-v2 -> candidates embed-lite, embed-v2
[12:10:02.045] worker-12: picked embed-lite for inputs [0,3,5]
[12:10:02.048] worker-13: picked embed-v2 for inputs [1,2,4,6]
[12:10:02.129] worker-12: timed out on sub-batch -> retried on worker-17
[12:10:02.180] worker-17: returned 3 vectors (dim=128)
[12:10:02.191] worker-13: returned 4 vectors (dim=512)
[12:10:02.210] rerank-svc: pairwise comparisons triggered for indices [0,1,2,3] -> produced 3*4=12 pairwise rows
[12:10:02.215] billing: emitted events: embed_units=7, pairwise_units=3
[12:10:02.216] invoice-agg: merged events -> invoice_units=10
```

sam-support: The client says they never hit the rerank endpoint directly. Why was rerank invoked?

mina-ml: Our SDK has a convenience path where if options.pairwise=true we asynchronously call the rerank microservice on behalf of the user to compute pairwise scores. If that happened, pairwise units are billed on top of embeddings. If reorder/collapse happens in dashboard, it might show only embeddings returned but not the internal pairwise charge details, causing the discrepancy.

todd-billing: I examined the billing event logs for req_f3a2b1c. There are two distinct billing records: evt_9001 (embed_units=7) and evt_9002 (pairwise_units=3). The invoice aggregates them. Dashboard vector count only reflects embed vectors (7). Invoice shows combined units (10).

maria-eng: Two additional issues: 1) the retry caused worker-12's initial vectors and the retry vectors to have different worker_ids and timestamps; dedupe logic uses canonical input_hash + latest_worker_id, but retried arrivals sometimes bypass dedupe if ordering flips. 2) rerank was invoked based on options flag, which we should be surfacing more clearly in usage UI and webhook logs.

mina-ml: I ran a quick staging repro with pairwise=true and forced a sub-batch retry. Repro matched customer: dashboard vectors=7, invoice units=10. Logs: billing emitted separate pairwise event and aggregator merged.

deploy-bot: Started job simulate-pairwise-retry-171234 on staging (job_id job_4512).

todd-billing: Root causes identified: 1) SDK convenience rerank call triggers additional billable work not obvious in basic embedding UI, 2) billing treats pairwise charges as separate invoice lines aggregated with embeddings, 3) retries can create duplicate arrivals that slip through dedupe window when paired with async rerank calls.

maria-eng: Short-term mitigations: - show pairwise/ rerank line items in the dashboard UI and API usage breakdown - add a warning in SDK when pairwise=true that it will invoke rerank and bill accordingly - increase dedupe window to 10s for embedding flows that trigger rerank (to catch delayed retries)

todd-billing: I'll flag invoice DataLoop-2026-03-04 for manual review and issue a provisional credit for the 3 units pending confirmation. Marking P2 but customer-facing.

mina-ml: Long-term fixes: - attach canonical input_hash and request_id to every rerank job so billing can attribute pairwise events to the parent embeddings request - change billing aggregator to compute units from actual output dims and pairwise row counts instead of optimistic estimators - update SDK to return structured usage metadata in responses (embedding_count, pairwise_count, billed_units)

maria-eng: I'll open PRs: runtime: propagate input_hash -> rerank job; sdk: explicit opt-in for auto-rerank and clearer docs; billing: attribute pairwise events and update aggregator logic.

sam-support: I told the customer we're issuing a provisional credit and that we'll update them once the billing patch lands. They'll accept that for now.

todd-billing: Credit applied (manual note: -3 units). Billing ticket BILL-487 created. Will follow up when aggregator change is rolled out.

sam-support: Thanks all, closing this thread once aggregator patch is merged and customer confirms credit.
